full_current_w2t3x_canonical.title: Measure publish-to-present latency in the runtime; report in /admin/status
full_current_w2t3x_canonical.description:
Outcome: the runtime measures, for each zone/widget publish, the time from admission to the present of the first frame that shows it, and reports p50/p90/p99/max in /admin/status. This is the server-side half of a publish-to-photon latency measurement with a stated budget (the benchmark + budget sibling consumes it).

Why: there is no publish-to-pixels measurement on the real Windows host and no budget. Baseline 2026-10-06 (owner host over the tailnet): MCP publish round trip p50 5.0 ms / p90 7.8 ms; idle CPU ~0%. The user-test-performance skill (.claude/skills/user-test-performance/SKILL.md) measures client-side e2e RTT and throughput only. Telemetry (crates/tze_hud_telemetry/src/record.rs) has frame_time_us and input-driven latencies (input_to_local_ack_us :112, input_to_scene_commit_us :118, input_to_next_present_us :124), none starting at a publish. /admin/status (operator/status.rs) reports only frames_presented (counted for the primary only, lifecycle.rs:2239 in the PR #1336 tree) and cpu_pct.

Non-goals: true photon timing (needs a camera or DXGI frame statistics); damage tracking; changing the frame loop's cadence.

Cold start: repo /home/orca/orca/projects/tze-hud. Read CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, docs/vision.md, docs/scope.md and docs/api.md first. Work in a worktree (scripts/worktree-add.sh .worktrees/<name> -b <branch>) off origin/main. Gates: `just ci`; GPU tests via `just test-gpu` (never bare cargo test -p tze_hud_compositor); Windows-only code via `just clippy-windows-gnu` plus Windows CI. Line numbers below are as of origin/main 788e5210 (or the PR #1336 branch where stated) and may drift.
full_current_w2t3x_canonical.design:
- Stamp a monotonic Instant at publish admission (the scene commit for MCP hud_publish and gRPC Publish, zones and widgets). Keep at most one pending probe per surface per frame (coalesced publishes share the frame; record each publish's own start).
- At present (main thread, lifecycle.rs maybe_present_frame after present_pending_texture; and secondary presents after PR #1336, since zones can live on secondaries), resolve probes whose commit is included in that frame and record present - admission into a fixed-bucket histogram (no per-sample allocation; a bounded ring of the last ~1024 samples or log-linear buckets) in tze_hud_telemetry.
- /admin/status: `publish_to_present_ms: {n, p50, p90, p99, max}` over the window; document that photon = present + up to one refresh interval of scanout.
- Zero cost when idle (no probes, no wakes). Depends on hud-1pt5h: the present path is rewritten by PR #1336.
